title: Mobile Employee Endpoint Responsibility Policy
summary: This policy establishes security requirements for employees using mobile devices or endpoint computers for company business outside of an office setting. It covers the protection of company-issued devices and the handling of company data on such devices.
scope: This policy applies to any mobile device, or endpoint computer issued by <Company Name> or used for <Company Name> business which contains stored data owned by <Company Name>.

requirements.text: All employees shall assist in protecting devices issued by <Company Name> or storing <Company Name> data.
Users are expressly forbidden from storing <Company Name> data on devices that are not issued by <Company Name>, such as storing <Company Name> email on a personal cell phone or PDA.
Employees are to notify the security department immediately if they see error messages for Secunia, Anti-virus and Endpoint security products.
Employees shall run an online malware scanner at least once a month for a “second opinion”.
After installing a Browser Add-on, employees shall run a browser testing tool.
